common.nonClinicalNotice: Operational Decision Notice: This is an estimated accessibility index based on socio-geographic friction factors. This is NOT a medical diagnosis.

landing.heroTag: National Healthcare Accessibility Platform • Non-Clinical Architecture
landing.heroSubtitle: PFIS identifies practical barriers (from transit deficits and documentation gaps to wage loss) preventing patients from completing care, helping healthcare systems choose high-impact interventions.
landing.problemTitle: Why 74% of patient dropouts happen before the doctor consultation.
landing.problemDesc: Traditional healthcare software assumes building a hospital is enough. Vulnerable patients encounter severe non-clinical friction:
landing.transportDeficitDesc: No direct rural buses or unaffordable private auto fares over 40+ km distances.
landing.wageLossDesc: Rigid morning queues force daily wage earners to sacrifice essential food income.
landing.digitalExclusionDesc: Feature phone users unable to navigate smartphone apps or scan token QR codes.
landing.paperworkGapsDesc: Missing identity links preventing cashless Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) claims.
landing.simulatorTitle: Simulate community interventions to evaluate estimated access gains.
landing.simulatorDesc: Model estimated care completion gains when community transport, satellite diagnostic camps, or community escorts are deployed.
landing.zeroDiagnosis: Zero Disease Diagnosis: PFIS does NOT diagnose diseases or prescribe medication.
landing.consentArch: Patient Consent: No patient data is transmitted without explicit authorization.
landing.explainableAI: Transparent Scoring: Every barrier score provides clear operational and mathematical rationale.
